cards.sub: Crystal-clear rivers in Mato Grosso do Sul: the cheap day costs US$ 13, the famous snorkel US$ 85+

cards.nota: The TCA is paid online only, at turistapornatureza.com.br, before you arrive. Kids up to 7 are exempt. The cheapest swim is on the next slide.
In reais: R$ 70–98, R$ 120–180, R$ 185, R$ 349–438 and R$ 470–570. 2026 reference prices: confirm with your agency.

linhas: Taxi to the cave and back
cards.nota: Almost no attraction is in town and there's no public bus to them: budget for transfers.

itens: Vouchers only
You can't buy at the gate: book through a local agency.
Same price everywhere
Prices are fixed in town, so every agency charges the same.
Book early
Each site takes a fixed number of visitors a day.
No sunscreen
It's banned at some springs. Check your tour's rules.

alt: Cover: What Bonito really costs. Fish in a crystal-clear river in Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul

Daily costs: self-service lunch US$ 5 to 6, taxi in town about US$ 4, shared transfer about US$ 5, taxi to the cave and back about US$ 27, Praça da Liberdade free

cards.titulo: Data in Brazil: US$ 6 a month or US$ 25 a week?
cards.sub: Local SIM vs travel eSIM: what each costs and how to get one with just your passport

cards.nota: Carrier plans include unlimited WhatsApp. Travel eSIM: Airalo and Holafly unlimited-data plans, bought before you fly. How to get the local SIM is next.

itens: Go to a Claro store
Without a CPF, prepaid activation is in physical stores only.
Bring your passport
Claro accepts it as ID for the chip and for eSIM.
Pick a monthly plan
Prezão from R$ 35 with WhatsApp included.
Or buy a tourist eSIM
Claro and Vivo sell plans for visitors with a passport.
WhatsApp is everything
Tours, hosts and restaurants book and reply there.
Not all WhatsApp is free
TIM's unlimited WhatsApp skips video calls and links.
Free Wi-Fi exists
São Paulo has 7,800+ free city Wi-Fi points, slow but free.

alt: Cover: Data in Brazil, US$ 6 a month or US$ 25 a week? São Paulo skyline with a cable-stayed bridge

cards.titulo: Beyond Copacabana: 4 cities for New Year's Eve
cards.sub: 3 confirmed free parties and 1 five-day festival, with dates and what to book now

cards.nota: Fortaleza runs 3 stages with 26 acts. Recife puts QR-code wristbands on kids. The biggest party of all is on the next slide.
cards.rodape: Sources: city halls and local press

cards.texto: Dec 30 to Jan 3 at the Boca do Rio arena: 100+ hours of music, about 1 million people expected.
cards.dica: Last year it was free, with special buses. This year's entry rules aren't out yet: check before you go.

itens: Book your bed early
Dec 31 is peak season for rooms near the beach.
Go by bus or metro
Streets near the stages usually close that night.
Carry little
Phone in a front pocket, a little cash, no bag on the sand.
cards.rodape: Prices and line-ups can change: check the city sites

alt: Cover: Beyond Copacabana, 4 cities for New Year's Eve. A concert crowd seen from behind under stage lights
Free entry, confirmed: Recife, Praia do Pina, December 26, 27 and 31; Fortaleza, Praia de Iracema, December 30 and 31; São Paulo, Avenida Paulista, December 31
Salvador: Festival Virada Salvador, 5 days from December 30 to January 3 at the Boca do Rio arena; last year free, this year's entry rules not out yet
Budget tips: book your bed early, go by bus or metro, carry little
